actions.action: Check whether the plant was set deeper in the soil than it was originally
Review watering schedule and method for possible overwatering
Spray down the plant to remove anything it may be carrying
Check the type of water being used
Return the plant to the store and get a new one

verdict.reason: The scraped comments blame circulation, overwatering, water type or fertilizer, never insufficient light, and offer no light fix; the acclimation reassurance and overwatering suggestion could delay the needed move to brighter light.
